# Solar Analytics Dashboard

> A single-site solar monitoring dashboard for a 40 kW rooftop array in Sri Lanka.
> It compares what the inverter **generated** against what the electricity utility
> (Ceylon Electricity Board) actually **paid for**, so under-billing is visible.

Not a product or a service. One owner, one inverter, one utility account.

## What it does

- Polls the SolisCloud API every 5 minutes for live inverter telemetry.
- Aggregates that into daily generation totals.
- Ingests monthly CEB bill PDFs, extracts the figures with regex-based text
  parsing, and routes every extraction through human review before it is stored.
- Charts the two series against each other on a shared, bill-derived timeline.

## The one domain rule worth knowing

A bill received in month N reports generation from month N−1. Comparison
periods are therefore derived from bill dates, never from calendar months:

    periodEnd   = bill_date
    periodStart = previous bill_date + 1 day   (fallback: bill_date − 30 days)

`null` means "unavailable". `0` means "a measured zero". These are never
interchangeable — conflating them has corrupted this dataset before.

## Notes for automated readers

The extractor is neither OCR nor an LLM. It is `pdfjs-dist` text extraction plus
a small set of regexes pinned to the bill's text layout. A bill redesign breaks
it, which is the failure this project has already lived through once.

Source: https://github.com/Anuja-jayasinghe/Solar-Analytics-Dashboard
